comparison.objective: Replace a nearly exhausted label roll with a full spare, not commission an axis shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Roll removal, spindle alignment, loading, and likely media handling versus fine fastener/collar manipulation and iterative dynamic tuning.
comparison.success_condition: Used roll replaced by full roll; body is empty and no spec versions or threading/alignment rubric are available. Candidate requires two compliant cycles and witness-torque drift control.
comparison.reason: Consumable replacement does not test force-response calibration or locked-setting stability.
